name: Mohammed Rahman
headline: Senior UI Engineer (Desktop)
summary: UI engineer with 7 years designing and building desktop trading and logistics front ends in Java Swing and JavaFX. I focus on dense, keyboard-driven interfaces that traders and operators use all day.

experience.title: Senior Desktop UI Engineer
bullets: Lead the user interface for a desktop order-entry terminal in JavaFX, used by 1,200 traders across the Gulf.
Rebuilt the blotter grid in Java to render 50,000 live rows at 60 frames per second.
Created a themeable component kit styled with JavaFX CSS, including dark and high-contrast themes.
Moved the build to Maven and added JUnit tests for the view models, cutting UI regressions by 40%.

experience.title: UI Developer
bullets: Built Java Swing screens for berth planning and container tracking used in three ports.
Wrote the SQL behind the yard-occupancy views and took the slowest screen from 8 seconds to under 1.
Introduced Git and code review to a team of six that had been sharing code over network drives.
